title: South Florida This Week: Free Halloween, Food, Sports, Nightlife
igCaption:
Free first, then burgers, sports, concerts and Halloween night.

Sources: Miami New Times, Local 10, Eater Miami

#SouthFlorida #HalloweenWeekend #MiamiEvents #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: Need a plan this week? Start free, then pick the burger, the game, or the late night.
First free pick: LoveIsLove returns to Normandy Fountain on November 7. It is in its sixth year, and more than 1,200 people have already RSVP'd for the North Beach hip-hop block party.
scenes.caption: First free pick: LoveIsLove returns to Normandy Fountain on Nov. 7. It is in its sixth year, and more than 1,200 people have already RSVP'd for the North Beach hip-hop block party.

scenes.text: For food, Skinny Louie starts its Burger Shot takeover in early November and runs it through December 31. The Bleeder Triple costs $15.49, with three Black Angus smash patties, American cheese, bacon, pickles, barbecue sauce, and ketchup.

scenes.text: Monday night brings a sports equinox. MLB, NFL, NBA, WNBA, and NHL are all in play at the same time. If you’re watching the sports equinox out, NEAR shows who’s there too.

scenes.text: For a show, The Linda Lindas play Culture Room on Tuesday, October 27. Tickets cost $40 for the Los Angeles punk band.

scenes.text: Hocus Pocus runs at Factory Town from Friday, October 30, to Sunday, November 1. Tickets cost $120 to $250, with Chase & Status, Eric Prydz, Gorgon City, Indira Paganotto, Meduza, and Nora En Pure on the bill.

scenes.text: Pick one and keep the rest for next week. South Florida is full of quick passes and near misses, from late-night crowds to festival lines, and NEAR is what makes those anonymous faces turn into names.
